candidates.old:
.add_zone_column                    \ zone_tmp -> the list; keeps X and Y
{
    PHX
    LDX zone_n
    LDA zone_tmp_lo
    STA zone_lo,X
    LDA zone_tmp_hi
    STA zone_hi,X
    INC zone_n
    PLX
    RTS
}

\ span_in_zone: does [span_x - 1, span_x + A + 1] hold a zone column? C set if so. Keeps Y.
.span_in_zone
{
    CLC
    ADC #2
    STA span_w2
    LDA span_x_lo                   \ span_x -= 1 once (span_x is the caller's, dead after):
    BNE no_borrow                   \ then d = column - span_x
    DEC span_x_hi
.no_borrow
    DEC span_x_lo
    LDX zone_n
    BEQ lives
.each
    DEX
    LDA zone_hi,X                   \ d's high byte less 1 into span_d + 1 ...
    CLC
    SBC span_x_hi
    STA span_d + 1
    LDA zone_lo,X                   \ ... its low byte in A, C clear if it borrowed (ADC #0 below
    SEC                             \ makes span_d + 1 + C the high byte)
    SBC span_x_lo
    STA span_d
candidates.new:
.add_zone_column                    \ zone_tmp_lo, and A = zone_tmp_hi (every caller has just stored it) -> the list; keeps X and Y
{
    STX zone_tmp_hi                 \ X saved in zone_tmp_hi (dead: A holds it): 6 cycles where PHX/PLX is 7
    LDX zone_n
    INX
    STX zone_n
    STA zone_hi - 1,X
    LDA zone_tmp_lo
    STA zone_lo - 1,X
    LDX zone_tmp_hi
    RTS
}

candidates.summary: add_zone_column: A already holds zone_tmp_hi at every call, so skip its reload and save X in the dead zone_tmp_hi instead of PHX/PLX (37 -> 33 cycles a call, +1 byte via INX/STX); span_in_zone's loop drops the CLC before SBC span_x_hi (C is 0 at every entry to .each, -1 byte). Net 0 bytes, so nothing after the window moves. Overlaps candidates 2 and 3, which are its halves (alternatives).
candidates.equivalence: add_zone_column: all four callers (add_scroll_zone: right/arriving JSR, right/leaving JMP, left/arriving JSR, left/leaving JMP) run STA zone_tmp_hi immediately before the JSR/JMP with nothing in between, so A = zone_tmp_hi at entry. The routine stores A at zone_hi + n and zone_tmp_lo at zone_lo + n and leaves zone_n = n + 1 (INX/STX; the stores are indexed from zone_hi - 1 / zone_lo - 1, so X = n + 1 addresses entry n). X is saved in zone_tmp_hi (zero page, renderer-private in ren_zp; its only writers are the four callers' STA just before the call and its only reader was this routine's own LDA, now removed; nothing reads it after the routine) and restored by LDX before RTS; Y is untouched; A is clobbered as before (callers reload A next). Flags at return came from PLX, now from LDX: no caller reads them (JSR sites continue with LDA; JMP sites return to the add_scroll_zone caller, whose next flag use follows INY; CPY #2). Loop: .each is entered with C = 0 on every path. From the prefix: CLC; ADC #2 on A = a width from mover_types_width_table (max &0B = MOVER_WIDEST; span_in_zone's single caller is render.6502:456) gives C = 0, and STA, LDA, BNE, DEC zp, LDX, BEQ keep C. From .next (the only other way to .each, via TXA; BNE each): .next is reached by BNE next after ADC #0, taken only when the result is non-zero, and then the carry out is 0 (a carry out needs A + C = 256, which gives 0), or by falling out of BCS hit not taken, so C = 0; TXA keeps C. With C = 0, SBC span_x_hi is exactly CLC; SBC span_x_hi (zone_hi - span_x_hi - 1), and every later instruction is unchanged, so span_d, span_d + 1 and the final C are identical.
candidates.relies_on: All four add_zone_column call sites keep STA zone_tmp_hi directly before the call (A = zone_tmp_hi on entry), and zone_tmp_hi is read nowhere else (grep src/ and tools/). mover_types_width_table entries <= 253 (max &0B), single caller of span_in_zone. The block after the window: .next reached only with C = 0 (BNE next after ADC #0; fall through after BCS hit). Page crossings: byte-neutral overall (add_zone_column +1, loop -1), so .lives, width_of_type_A, mark_to_draw and everything after keep their addresses; inside the window every branch stays within page &97 (BEQ lives, BNE each, BNE next, BCS hit; debug_lives build &9719-&978F) and none moves across a page boundary. zone_lo/zone_hi are in page &BC (&BC5C-&BC63): the stores are abs,X (5 cycles whatever the crossing), the loop's loads are unchanged. Alternative to candidates 2 and 3.
